name: card
title: Card
description: Composable surface — Header, Title, Description, Content, Media, Footer — in default, outline and elevated styles. Pressable cards spring down and can light up with a spotlight that follows your finger or a glowing accent border.
summary: A composable card that springs down on press, with a spotlight that follows your finger.
usage:
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';

<Card variant="elevated" highlight="spotlight" onPress={openGuide}>
  <Card.Header>
    <Card.Title>Kyoto in autumn</Card.Title>
    <Card.Description>Temples, maple-lined paths and the best matcha spots.</Card.Description>
  </Card.Header>
</Card>
behavior: With onPress, onLongPress or pressable it scales down with a spring and bounces back on release.
highlight="spotlight" springs in a soft glow under your finger; highlight="border" fades in a glowing accent ring.
Becomes a button with disabled state when it has onPress or onLongPress. Card.Title is a header.
Shows a pointer cursor when it has onPress.
props: Surface style. Glass is translucent with a light edge — place it over colour or imagery.
Makes the card a button with a spring press.
Radial glow that tracks the finger, or an accent border that glows in.
Element pinned to the header's top-right.
Clamp the text to this many lines with an ellipsis.
Plain section view / bottom row of actions (row, 10pt gap); `style` overrides either.
Style for the card surface (merged after the variant background, border and radius).
